spans.s: A weapon, a cudgel or a short sword.
A stick shaped like a sword (Mar. गुप्ति). (करवालिका).
The middle arch of a niche; Gīrvāṇa.
इलिनी [ilinī], N. of the daughter of मेधातिथि.
इली [ilī], [इल्-क ङीष्] A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword, a short sword (करवाल).
इलीबिशः [ilībiśḥ], N. of a demon conquered by Indra; न्याविध्यदिलीबिशस्य दृह्ळा
इलीशः [ilīśḥ] इल्लिशः [illiśḥ], इल्लिशः A sort of fish, commonly hilsa or sable. इलीशोचितपीयूषो वाचा वाचामगोचरः Udb.
ईलिनः [īlinḥ], N. of a son of Tamsu and father of Duṣyanta. -नी f. N. of a daughter of Medhātithi; Hariv.
